decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster is a core extension of the firm's coolant management offer, carries invested development effort and public commitment, and fits the announced direction toward efficient production, so management persists with it.
The nozzle line is a low-cost, visible complement to the firm's coolant systems, so management would at most trim individual models rather than abandon the line it committed to.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a staple of the established conveying business and central to the firm's identity, so withdrawal is very unlikely.
The magnetic belt conveyor builds on the established chip conveyor range and serves metalworking customers directly, so sunk investment and portfolio fit keep it on the market.
Hinged belt conveyors are a core standard product of the material flow offering and are tied to the firm's public positioning, so management keeps them.
